title: Handling of DNN based congestion control

entities.name: DNN based congestion control
entities.description: Procedure performed by AMF when DNN congestion criteria are met. Includes detection and activation of congestion control mechanisms.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that detects congestion and performs congestion control procedures.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that performs congestion control procedures when DNN based congestion control is activated.

entities.name: DNN
entities.description: Data Network Name used for identifying the network and for congestion control procedures.

entities.name: DNN congestion criteria
entities.description: Criteria specified in 3GPP TS 23.501 that trigger DNN based congestion control when met.

entities.name: Non-emergency PDU session
entities.description: PDU session type where DNN must be provided by UE or selected by AMF for congestion control.

relations.description: AMF starts performing DNN based congestion control when congestion criteria are met.
DNN based congestion control is triggered when DNN congestion criteria are met.
AMF uses selected DNN or DNN associated with PDU session when UE does not provide DNN for non-emergency PDU session.
AMF performs congestion control procedures when DNN based congestion control is activated.
UE performs congestion control procedures when DNN based congestion control is activated.
DNN must be provided or selected for non-emergency PDU sessions.
